The fanfare should target followers on your field generally, but selfFollower may exclude amulet/follower ambiguity depending on engine semantics; ensure it can select your followers on field up to 2 times as stated.

The first effect is incorrectly encoded as tutorFromCemetery to field; it should summon the selected "Rulenye, Omen of Silence" from your cemetery, e.g. with summonFromCemetery filtered to that identity.

The start-of-end-phase ability is incomplete; after removing a divine water counter, it should check whether this has no divine water counters, then bury this card and deal 5 damage to each enemy follower on the field. Replace the noop with that conditional resolution.
The parsed card incorrectly adds an activated ability with pp 1, engage, and burySelf to deal 5 damage to one enemy follower; no such activated ability exists in the source and it should be removed.

The missing "if this has no divine water counters" condition is not supported by the listed conditions; implement a condition for source counter count / no counters remaining so the end-phase effect can be encoded correctly.
